definition: מַשְׂאֵת noun feminine uprising, utterance, burden, portion (on formation compare Ol § 109 a Sta § 272 b Kö ii. 1, 183 ; Phoenician (Pun) has משאת = payment, tax see Lzb 326 ); — absolute ׳ מ Judg 20:40 +; construct מַשְׂאַת Gen 43:34 +; plural absolute מַשְׂאֹת Gen 43:34 , + (probably) מַשְׂאוֺת Lam 2:14 (see below); construct מַשְׂאֹת Gen 43:34 — 1. that which rises, uprising, uplifting: \ \ a. הֶעָשָׁן ׳ מ Judg 20:38 uprising of smoke , compare ( ׳ הֶע omitted) v Judg 20:40 . \ \ b. in general = signal Jer 6:1 (= נֵס Gf .). \ \ c. uplifting of hands ( כַּפַּי ) in prayer Ps 141:2 (|| תְּפִלָּה ). 2. utterance, oracle (= III. מַשָּׂא ), Lam 2:14 ( Bu Löhr). 3. burden Zeph 3:18 (of reproach, figurative). 4. a. portion (carried to some one), especially from table of king or superior, Gen 43:34 (3 t. in verse) ( J ; on custom see Di and references), 2Sam 11:8 so read perhaps also 2Sam 19:43 (for ᵑ0 נִשֵּׂאת ) Gr HPS . \ \ b. perhaps also more generally, present, largess from a superior Jer 40:5 ( + אֲרֻחָה food-allowance ), Esth 2:18 ( כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ ). \ \ c. exacted or enforced gift , from inferior, בַּר ׳ מ Amos 5:11 (compare Phoenician above; see also מנחה ). \ \ d. sacred contribution, tax משֶׁה ׳ מ ( ׳ י ) עֶבֶד 2Chr 24:6 ; 2Chr 24:9 . \ \ e. offering to ׳ י Ezek 20:40 .

BDB5393 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB5395

מַשְׂאֵת noun feminine uprising, utterance, burden, portion (on formation compare Ol§ 109 a Sta§ 272 b Köii. 1, 183; Phoenician (Pun) has משאת = payment, tax see Lzb326); — absolute ׳מ Judg 20:40 +; construct מַשְׂאַת Gen 43:34 +; plural absolute מַשְׂאֹת Gen 43:34, + (probably) מַשְׂאוֺת Lam 2:14 (see below); construct מַשְׂאֹת Gen 43:34 —

1. that which rises, uprising, uplifting:
\ \ a. הֶעָשָׁן ׳מ Judg 20:38 uprising of smoke, compare (׳הֶע omitted) vJudg 20:40.
\ \ b. in general = signal Jer 6:1 (= נֵס Gf.).
\ \ c. uplifting of hands (כַּפַּי) in prayer Ps 141:2 (|| תְּפִלָּה).
2. utterance, oracle (= III. מַשָּׂא), Lam 2:14 (Bu Löhr).
3. burden Zeph 3:18 (of reproach, figurative).
4. a. portion (carried to some one), especially from table of king or superior, Gen 43:34 (3 t. in verse) (J; on custom see Di and references), 2Sam 11:8 so read perhaps also 2Sam 19:43 (for ᵑ0 נִשֵּׂאת) Gr HPS.
\ \ b. perhaps also more generally, present, largess from a superior Jer 40:5 ( + אֲרֻחָה food-allowance), Esth 2:18 (כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ).
\ \ c. exacted or enforced gift, from inferior, בַּר ׳מ Amos 5:11 (compare Phoenician above; see also מנחה).
\ \ d. sacred contribution, tax משֶׁה ׳מ (׳י) עֶבֶד 2Chr 24:6; 2Chr 24:9.
\ \ e. offering to ׳י Ezek 20:40.
